description: Column definitions and field access boundaries for Delhi V6 synthetic dataset

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: amount
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Total monetary defrauded amount (INR)

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: log_amount
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Log-transformed fraud amount log1p(amount)

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: amount_bucket
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Binned transaction amount (micro, low, medium, high, severe)

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: fraud_type
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Categorical fraud modus operandi (9 categories)

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: payment_channel
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Payment channel used (upi, imps, neft, rtgs, card_p2p, crypto_p2p)

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: event_timestamp
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Timestamp of primary fraud execution

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: reported_at
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Timestamp when formal complaint was lodged

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: reporting_delay_minutes
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Elapsed duration between crime execution and reporting

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: victim_district
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Revenue district where victim resides / complaint originated

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: victim_lat
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Victim location latitude

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: victim_lon
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Victim location longitude

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: victim_bank_group
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Victim banking institution group

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: transaction_count
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Total transfers logged along the laundering flow

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: transaction_hop_count
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Graph hop count from victim to terminal account

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: beneficiary_account_count
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Count of unique layer-1 beneficiary accounts

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: mule_account_count
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Total intermediate mule accounts identified

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: distinct_bank_count
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Number of distinct banking entities involved

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: terminal_mule_district
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Revenue district of the terminal mule account bank branch

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: account_district_count
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Number of distinct districts traversed across the account chain

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: dominant_account_district
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: District containing the highest number of accounts in the chain

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: dominant_account_district_share
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Proportion of accounts belonging to dominant district

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: beneficiary_geo_consistency
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Proportion of layer-1 beneficiaries co-located with victim or terminal district

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: terminal_vs_majority_account_distance_km
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Centroid distance between terminal account and majority account cluster

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: cross_district_transfer_count
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Number of intra-chain transfers that cross district boundaries

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: geographic_dispersion_score
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Standard distance radius of banking footprint

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: transaction_velocity
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Transfers completed per hour

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: transfer_burst_score
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Concentration of transfers within 15-minute bursts

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: graph_depth
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Maximum path length in the mule transaction tree

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: graph_branching_factor
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Average out-degree of laundering nodes

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: night_activity_ratio
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Proportion of transfers occurring between 22:00 and 06:00

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: weekend_flag
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Binary indicator for weekend event

CONTEXT_FEATURE.name: historical_district_crime_density
CONTEXT_FEATURE.description: Rolling historical crime index for victim district

CONTEXT_FEATURE.name: commercial_hub_proximity_km
CONTEXT_FEATURE.description: Distance from victim to nearest major Delhi commercial node

LATENT_GENERATION_ONLY.name: latent_archetype
LATENT_GENERATION_ONLY.description: Hidden synthetic operational archetype governing movement logic

LATENT_GENERATION_ONLY.name: generator_target_distribution
LATENT_GENERATION_ONLY.description: Synthetic multinomial probability array over 60 clusters

TARGET.name: realized_cashout_cluster_id
TARGET.description: Target operational cluster where cash-out took place (1..60)

TARGET.name: realized_cashout_district
TARGET.description: Revenue district where cash-out took place (11 districts)

TARGET.name: realized_cashout_minutes
TARGET.description: Elapsed duration until cash-out occurred (regression target for Time model)
